visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The camera pans across a light-toned wooden floor toward a multi-tiered wooden bookshelf filled with colorful children's picture books and boxed toys. To the left, a white rug with small multi-colored dots is visible next to several plush, flower-shaped cushions in white and grey. (2) A medium shot captures a ginger and white cat lying inside a large, white flower-shaped plush cushion. The cat's eyes are half-closed in a relaxed state. The background is a white wall featuring a grid of small perforated holes and soft lighting. (3) The camera zooms into an extreme close-up of the cat's face as its eyes slowly blink. The cat's pink nose is covered in small, dark spots. Its white whiskers are prominent against its orange fur as it rests its chin on the soft cushion. (4) A visual cut shows a wide shot of the room at night with warmer, dimmer lighting. The cat is sitting upright on the white dotted rug near the bookshelf. The room is tidy with wooden stools and a white beanbag chair in the background. (5) In a medium shot, the cat remains on the rug and performs a wide, dramatic yawn, exposing its mouth and pink tongue. Its white front paws are folded neatly in front of it in a loaf position. (6) The final frame is a solid pink screen with a white minimalist text logo centered in the frame.
